text.text: We let the architecture bend to Villimalé’s natural conditions, so the island’s character guides how it grows.
The dead edges become open, active public space that brings the community together and joins the island’s green links.
Back of house to front of house
The parti in four steps, from the island as it is to the island as proposed.
The current condition prioritises rigid development, forcing nature and island life to adapt to the built environment.
Natural flows of people, landscape, wind and activity are woven together to create continuous movement and stronger connections.
